author: blu
body: Upkeep lifegain. Farmstead (UpkeepGain) gains its controller 1 life at their upkeep -- the mirror of the upkeep-damage family (Karma/Copper Tablet). do-upkeep- step now sums UpkeepGain statics the active player controls and applies the life gain alongside the damage sources. With a Farmstead, life 20 -> 21; without, no change.
